metric: Count of newly accessioned digital archive objects, measured in whole objects.
population: Only collection ALPHA in archive EAST; exclude pre-existing objects and deleted entries.
window: Accession timestamps from 2026-10-01 00:00:00 UTC inclusive to 2026-11-01 00:00:00 UTC exclusive.
basis: Count each distinct object ID once; duplicate IDs do not add to the total. Use accession time.
